name: audio-recorder
title: Audio Recorder
description: Record meetings, microphone and system audio locally as M4A or WAV, with pause, resume and a searchable recording library.
author: radouane-tamouss

commands.name: recorder
commands.title: Audio Recorder
commands.description: Record audio and manage previous recordings

preferences.name: mode
